question: Which country records the MOST stroke deaths every year?

post.premise: One country carries a third of the world's stroke deaths
post.bait: Most people guess wrong by a factor of sixteen.
post.sources_line: The Lancet Neurology (GBD 2021); Chinese Medical Journal (GBD 2021 China); CDC; World Stroke Organization

youtube.title: Which country has the most stroke deaths? World Stroke Day quiz 🧠
youtube.description:
Three big countries. One of them carries about a third of all the world's stroke deaths every single year, sixteen times the US figure.
Say your answer out loud before the map gives it away, then learn the four letters that save a life this World Stroke Day.
Follow for one body fact a day that is worth an argument.

instagram.caption:
Which country records the MOST stroke deaths every year? 🧠
United States, India or the other one? About a third of the world's stroke deaths happen in a single country, and the number is sixteen times the US toll.
It is World Stroke Day this week. Which did you pick?

threads.text: Which country records the most stroke deaths every year — United States, India or China? About a third of the world's seven million stroke deaths happen in one of them, sixteen times the US toll. World Stroke Day is this week; the four FAST letters are at the end.

intent: A World Stroke Day Short that stays a map story: three giants, one answer, the scale shown as counters that keep climbing, then the FAST card as the thing you actually take away.

v04.text: China. Over 2 million stroke deaths every year, about 1 in 3 of the whole world's total.

v05.text: The United States loses about 165,000 a year. China's toll is 16 times that.

v06.text: Worldwide, stroke kills more than 7 million people every single year, the third most common cause of death on Earth.

v07.text: World Stroke Day is October 29. Remember FAST: face, arm, speech, and time to call for help.

research.topic: Stroke deaths by country: China ~2.6 million stroke deaths in 2021 (GBD 2021), about one third of the 7.3 million worldwide; USA 165,393 (2022, CDC/AHA); World Stroke Day 29 October; FAST signs

myths.myth: The United States, with its famous heart-disease problem, has the most stroke deaths.
myths.reality: The US recorded 165,393 stroke deaths in 2022; China recorded about 2.6 million in 2021 — roughly sixteen times more, from about four times the population.

landscape.our_gap: Stroke-awareness Shorts are talking-head FAST explainers; nobody shows the global scale on a map with the three obvious countries, two live counters and the FAST card at the end.
